visibility.overflow_policy: shorten-or-split-copy-before-layout; do not reduce body below baseline to force-fit

transition.invariant: At transition i -> i+1, item i stays fully visible throughout and after the transition as the previous item; only item i-1 may leave.
transition.retention: Item i may leave only when item i+2 arrives.
transition.hold_duration: TBD: validate against lyric density and reading time

validation: Static post-transition concept inspected; temporal behavior not implemented or verified.
